name: n4_poll
description: Poll one BQL select over a short window in ONE call (retro R5 dD7), instead of a scratch stdio driver and summarizer per live test: the select runs samples times (default 6, 1 to 40), interval_s apart (default 5, at least 1), on a fixed schedule from the first sample, and the whole poll spans at most 40 s from the first sample to the last so the reply comes back inside an MCP client's 60 s request limit (a longer span is refused: poll again). base and query are as n4_bql_query takes them over a station subtree (select <cols> from <type> [where ...]). Before the first sample the SystemService systemTime is read once: clock {station_time, local_time (this machine at the middle of that read), offset_s (station minus local), uncertainty_s (half the round trip)}, or {note} when it cannot be read, never a guessed offset. samples lists each read {t (seconds from the first sample), local_time, row_count, elapsed_ms, truncated?, rows} or {t, local_time, error}: a failed sample is kept and the poll goes on, a query the tool refuses fails the call at the first sample, and a lost station session (Could not find Server Session) ends the poll early with ended session_lost and the samples so far (reconnect with n4_connect, then poll again); ended is complete otherwise. series follows each cell across the samples, a row named by its first column (e.g. slotPath) and every other column a cell: {row, column, first, last, changes, min?, max?} (min and max when every value read as a number, a locale decimal comma and a trailing unit allowed), at most 200 cells. Read-only: the same select, samples times, plus one SystemService load.

query.description: select <columns> from <type> [where ...], e.g. select slotPath, out from control:NumericPoint

base.description: Subtree ORD the select runs over (default: the station root)

interval_s.description: Seconds between the starts of two reads; (samples - 1) x interval_s is at most 40

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout of each read in seconds
